sample_vertex_features_from_feature_map: sample vertex features from an image feature map using bilinear interpolation with normalized vertex coordinates
sample_features_with_nearest_interpolati: sample vertex features from a feature map using nearest neighbor interpolation mode instead of bilinear
sample_features_with_padding_modes: sample vertex features from a feature map using zeros, reflection, or border padding for out-of-range vertices
sample_features_return_packed: sample vertex features from a feature map and return packed features flattened across batch and vertex dimensions
sample_features_from_multiple_feature_ma: sample vertex features from a list of feature maps with different channel or spatial dimensions and concatenate results
